modules.name: mod-playerbots
modules.title: Playerbots
modules.description: Hundreds of AI players who level, quest, group, run dungeons and fight in battlegrounds.

modules.name: mod-ah-bot-plus
modules.title: Auction House Bot
modules.description: Keeps the auction house stocked and buys player listings, for a living economy.

modules.name: mod-dungeon-clear
modules.title: Dungeon Clear
modules.description: Lets a tank bot lead your party through a whole dungeon automatically (.dc on).

modules.name: mod-llm-chatter
modules.title: AI Bot Chatter
modules.description: Bots talk naturally in party, say and general chat using a local AI model (needs a good graphics card).

modules.name: mod-dungeon-master
modules.title: Dungeon Master
modules.description: Randomly generated dungeon runs and a roguelike challenge mode, from an NPC in each capital.

modules.name: mod-mounts-on-account
modules.title: Account-wide Mounts
modules.description: Mounts learned on one character become available to your other characters.

modules.name: mod-autobalance
modules.title: AutoBalance
modules.description: Dungeons and raids scale to the size of your group, so you can clear them with a few friends or bots.

modules.name: mod-solo-lfg
modules.title: Solo Dungeon Finder
modules.description: Queue for the dungeon finder alone or in a small group - no full group of five needed.

modules.name: mod-learn-spells
modules.title: Learn Spells Automatically
modules.description: New class spells are learned the moment you level up - no trips back to the trainer.

modules.name: mod-aoe-loot
modules.title: Area Loot
modules.description: Loot every nearby corpse at once with a single click.

modules.name: mod-transmog
modules.title: Transmogrification
modules.description: Change how your gear looks. Type .transmog portable in game to call the transmogrifier.

modules.name: mod-account-achievements
modules.title: Account-wide Achievements
modules.description: Achievements earned on one character count for all your characters.

modules.name: mod-random-enchants
modules.title: Random Enchants
modules.description: Looted, crafted and quest items can roll random bonus enchantments, Diablo style.

modules.name: mod-dynamic-xp
modules.title: Dynamic XP
modules.description: Leveling speeds up the higher you get, so the long middle levels go faster (on top of the XP speed).

modules.name: mod-boss-announcer
modules.title: Boss Kill Announcements
modules.description: Tells the whole server when a group defeats a raid boss.

modules.name: mod-skip-dk-starting-area
modules.title: Skip the Death Knight Intro
modules.description: New Death Knights can skip the long starting quest chain (Wrath only).

modules.name: mod-individual-progression
modules.title: Individual Progression
modules.description: Every character travels through Vanilla, then Burning Crusade, then Wrath at their own pace, with the original content restored.
modules.note: Big change to the world: best chosen for a new server, with Game version set to Full Wrath.

addons.name: MultiBot
addons.title: MultiBot
addons.description: Buttons and menus to control your bots (invite, follow, stay, attack, strategies) instead of typing commands.

addons.name: DungeonClear
addons.title: Dungeon Clear panel
addons.description: On / Off / Skip / Pause buttons and a boss list for automatic dungeon clears.

addons.name: Chatter
addons.title: Chatter Companion
addons.description: See and edit your bots' personalities and backstories for the AI chatter (/chatter).
